intro: Ak'Zeloth is an early Horde quest dispatched by the warlock Neeru Fireblade from deep within Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. Driven by evidence of lingering demonic corruption, Neeru sends adventurers into the Barrens to rendezvous with his field contact stationed near the border.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Since the last great war when the Burning Legion was defeated, I have searched for sources of demonic corruption in orc society. The collar you brought me confirms my fears.
It belongs to the Burning Blade, a cult that rallies around an item of demonic power. It is called the Demon Seed, and it resides in the Barrens atop Dreadmist Peak. It must be destroyed!
Go to Far Watch Post, on the border of the Barrens to the west, and speak with my assistant, Ak'Zeloth. He will direct you further.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Neeru wants the Demon Seed destroyed, does he? Strange...
Very well. If he wishes the seed gone, then I will tell you how to remove it.
